scope: Accepted only for the proven legacy PowerTab 1.7 ptab-4 browser profile: song files, guitar-only content, one standard-tuned six-string guitar player, one staff, one active voice, simple complete 4/4 measures, and the bounded structures demonstrated by the canonical fixture. This is not arbitrary .ptb compatibility.

provenance.musicalContent: Project-authored original six-position, two-measure guitar specimen
provenance.generationMethod: Deterministic project-authored Node.js serializer implementing only the exact PowerTab 1.7 MFC-style structures required by this fixture, based on the preserved legacy serialization source.

validation.deterministicRegeneration: passed; generator reproduces the exact 723-byte canonical binary and SHA-256
validation.powerTabEditorSourceFaithfulCompiledHarn: passed; pinned 2.0.22 v1.7 deserialization order and field layouts parsed the complete document, including internal barline 50 and exact footer
validation.tuxGuitarExactParserSourceExecution: passed; exact PTInputStream.java and PTFileFormatDetector.java Git blobs executed locally with model/API stubs only, preserving parser bytes unchanged
validation.semanticParity: passed for title, artist, six-string tuning, internal barline at 50, six positions, coordinates, durations, one rest, six notes total, and final two-note chord
validation.browserImporter: passed complete automated gate: 57 test suites and 343 tests; production build passed
validation.hostedCandidate: passed build, bounded artifact inspection, Pages deployment, and live network read-back
validation.realIphoneVoiceOver: passed on August 10, 2026: load, PowerTab 1.7 identification, focus recovery, all six positions, measure transition, rest, final two-note chord, and Previous/Next navigation
validation.reasonFullApplicationsRemainPending: Exact source-level execution evidence is stronger than static inspection for both parser families and the Guitar Eyes browser implementation has now passed its own automated, hosted, and real-device acceptance gates.

interruptionRecovery.ruleApplied: Reconstructed exact repository, branch, head, active or queued runs, preserved evidence, and remaining gate before resuming.
interruptionRecovery.defectFound: The provisional evidence commit mixed the older 698-byte one-measure binary/base64 with the newer 723-byte two-measure source, generator, verifier, README, and manifest.
interruptionRecovery.repairRule: Fail forward from the preserved newer generation; do not rewrite newer provenance around the stale binary.

provenance.restriction: Accepted only for the exact bounded ptab-4 PowerTab 1.7 profile proven here. Historical file-version values 1, 2, and 3 and all unproven legacy structures must still fail explicitly; do not infer broader .ptb support from this acceptance.
